name: Lana Del Rey
sources: style-research-extended-2 vol.2 pop-2020s — Lana Del Rey
notes: Slow cinematic torch-pop with hip-hop-derived low end, and one of the few models here that keeps the parent's half-time class: "backbeat is half-time — the snare lands on 3 — and many tracks are rubato/drumless", so `halfTime` is true at `halftime_3` and the separation from the parent comes from everything else. "Sparse trap-derived kick with a snare on 3, brushed or programmed; strings, harp and reverb do the work that a hat pattern would do elsewhere" is a kick density of 1—2, `hihat.continuous` false at `fillDensity` 0.06 with the roll vocabulary off, and a very quiet velocity tier table. "Where a kit appears it is loose and behind the beat" is the loosest humanize block in this batch: `quantizeStrength` 0.66 with double-digit jitter on every lane. The low end is ONE part, because the entry describes one: "808 sub and upright/electric bass on roots, very low and slow; the low end changes once per bar at most" names two timbres playing the same thing, and it ships as the bassline alone — a bass mirroring a kick that plays once a bar is "changes once per bar at most", a `followRootsProb` of 0.88 is "on roots", and the `[26, 46]` register is "very low". ⚠ `drums.bass808` is deliberately absent, as the parent `pop-2020s` also leaves it: the engine's 808 rides the kick's own ticks and pins itself to the *key* root, so authoring one here would lay a tonic drone over the bassline on the same onsets — one line played twice — and it could never play the moving roots of the i—VI—VII the entry asks for. The named "808 sub" is the patch a producer puts on that one low lane, not a second lane. Harmony is "4- or 8-bar loops of triads with added 6ths and 9ths" plus "heavy use of the natural-minor VI—VII and long tonic pedals", which is the family set, the high `triad` share, `colorTones` on 6 and 2, and the longest `chordDurationBeats` window in this section. Melody is "long-phrased, legato and descending, sitting in a narrow band with wide leaps into breathy falsetto for the hook" — descend-weighted contour, `long_arc`, 4- and 8-bar phrases, and an `octaveJumpProb` ceiling that is the falsetto flip. "Countermelody is a doubled-octave vocal" is `octave_echo`. ⚠ `confidence` is medium: the research rates it medium-high and states that "exact tempo/key bands are inferred", so every drum probability, the humanize numbers, the key list and `bpm.mode` 80 (the midpoint of the stated 70—90 core) are INFERRED here. ⛔ **The bass is `mirror_kick` rather than `reese_sustain`, and that is an engine limit rather than a reading of the record.** `reese_sustain` is the only rhythm `bass.rs` reads that holds a note, and it emits one note per chord — TASK-162, still open — so this model measured **285 distinct basslines in 1,000 seeds** on it against `bass.rs`'s floor of 500. `mirror_kick` with a high root lock is the roster-wide substitution for a sustained sub (`dmx`, `coolio`, `krs-one`, `mobb-deep` all record the same one), and over a kick that plays a sparse trap-derived 1 with a `2a` it reads as held at this tempo. The research is *"808 sub and upright/electric bass on roots, very low and slow; **the low end changes once per bar at most**"* — once a bar is what mirroring this kick writes, and it is a claim `reese_sustain`'s one-note-per-chord cannot make. The `m7` in `passingTones` is the *"heavy use of the natural-minor VI–VII and long tonic pedals"* line. ⚠ **INFERRED:** `followRootsProb` 0.88, `anticipationProb` 0.14 and the register's top moving 44 → 46 are lane-conventional, not sourced; `anticipationProb` is kept low because the drums are documented *"loose and behind the beat"* and a push is the opposite gesture. The register stays under `chords.voicing.register` [48, 76]. ⛔ **`cellShapes` came out and the sourced flat-7 moved into `passingTones` (2026-08-17, bassline variety floor).** The list led with `["1"]`, a one-degree cell of the root that says exactly what `followRootsProb` already says; and because `bass.rs` prefers a cell over `passingTones`, a third of the seeds played every note on the root with `followRootsProb` unreadable, while the rest read the cell and never the authored `P5`. Measured: **908 distinct basslines in 1,000 seeds**, a 0.908 share against `bass.rs`'s 0.95. ⚠ **Both colours the cells named are kept, in the parameter the engine reads when no cell is present**: the fifth was already there, and `m7` is the same flat-7 the `["1", "b7"]` cell was authored for — *"heavy use of the natural-minor VI–VII and long tonic pedals"*. A cell was never the researched claim in the first place; the entry says *"808 sub and upright/electric bass on roots, very low and slow; the low end changes once per bar at most"*, which is roots, and a colour reached from the root on the 12% of notes that leave it is what that line describes. Rhythm, register, root lock and anticipation are untouched.
